lead: A schema step's SQL is one statement per string, so an emitted `DECLARE … ; IF …` batch is wrong even where it is valid T-SQL.
body: `crates/nvs-db/src/direct.rs:142` is the contract — a driver takes a statement, never one string with several `;` in it. A step needing a value only the server holds writes one guarded statement instead, repeating its lookup rather than holding it in a variable: `crates/nvs-db/src/ddl.rs`'s `drop_default_constraint` is that shape.
